audited_objective: Make Lunar Lake an excellent profile-aware local inference appliance with a reliable dense Qwen route, earned OpenVINO GPU/NPU route promotion, protected BitNet CPU reference behavior, strict regression, and explicit claim boundaries.
decision_reason: The committed evidence supports profile-aware operator readiness, strict regression v2, bounded dense Qwen CPU/OpenVINO quality evidence, profile-scoped route promotion, BitNet semantic-intake protection, low_power blocked-ask and power-profile runbook guidance, route/model identity gates, Arc/NPU bounded proof gates, and BitNet CPU reference gates. SWARM-LNL258V-BITNET-INTAKE-009/#66 corrected the direct-reference prompt-token comparison boundary and closeout #68 recorded the tracker merge; semantic intake is now ready with rerun_required=false and strict regression/operator comparison ready. The objective is still not complete because LNL258V-POWER-006 has no real battery-mode low_power route/profile telemetry, the current energy-proxy evidence is AC-only, thermal temperature readings remain unavailable, and no benchmark-qualified low_power power advantage exists. A770 #62 plus closeout #74 are recorded as adjacent selected-device QK256 scaled OpenCL fixture evidence only and do not change Lunar Lake route promotion or BitNet QK256/I2_S claims. CUDA PERF-005 report-contract tests from #75 are adjacent benchmark-report guard coverage only and are not a Lunar Lake semantic trigger.
